# Command-line reference

<!-- Generated by `sidekick.export_reference`. Do not edit by hand. -->

The operator commands of a Sidekick installation. Each reads its settings from the environment (and `.env`), like the API; the operator's access to the host is the authorization. The text of every command and argument is the `help=` in its parser, so this page cannot drift from `--help`.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`sidekick-admin`](#sidekick-admin) | Create users, issue and revoke MCP tokens, and empty the trash. |
| [`sidekick-backup`](#sidekick-backup) | Create, verify, extract, import and prune encrypted local backups. |
| [`sidekick-owner-export`](#sidekick-owner-export) | Verify an owner export, plan or apply a restore, and write vCard or Markdown files. |
| [`sidekick-companion`](#sidekick-companion) | Pair, grant, list and revoke companion devices (the Android app). |
| [`sidekick-license`](#sidekick-license) | Store, show and clear the instance's license key. |
| [`sidekick-memory-worker`](#sidekick-memory-worker) | Run the derived-memory worker, or rebuild, wipe or forget memory. |
| [`sidekick-automation-worker`](#sidekick-automation-worker) | Run the process-run worker. |
| [`sidekick-backup-worker`](#sidekick-backup-worker) | Run the local backup worker. |
| [`sidekick-push-worker`](#sidekick-push-worker) | Run the push delivery worker. |
| [`sidekick-worker-health`](#sidekick-worker-health) | Check that a background worker is healthy (used by the container health checks). |

## `sidekick-admin`

Create users, issue and revoke MCP tokens, and empty the trash.

Run it with:

```
uv run --project backend sidekick-admin <command> [arguments]
```

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`create-user`](#sidekick-admin-create-user) | Create a user and print its UUID. |
| [`create-token`](#sidekick-admin-create-token) | Issue a personal access token for MCP clients and print it once. |
| [`list-tokens`](#sidekick-admin-list-tokens) | List a user's personal tokens as JSON (never the token itself). |
| [`revoke-token`](#sidekick-admin-revoke-token) | Revoke one personal token. |
| [`disable-user`](#sidekick-admin-disable-user) | Disable a user so none of their credentials work. |
| [`empty-trash`](#sidekick-admin-empty-trash) | Permanently remove everything in the trash (counts only unless --yes is given). |

### `sidekick-admin create-user`

Create a user and print its UUID.

| Argument | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--login` | `LOGIN` | yes | The user's login name. |
| `--display-name` | `DISPLAY_NAME` | yes | The name shown for the user. |

### `sidekick-admin create-token`

Issue a personal access token for MCP clients and print it once.

| Argument | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--user-id` | `USER_ID` | yes | The user the token belongs to. |
| `--label` | `LABEL` | yes | A name that tells the token apart in lists. |
| `--scope` | `SCOPE` | no | A scope the client needs; repeat once per scope. Required: no scope is implied. One of `automation:read`, `automation:write`, `contacts:read`, `contacts:write`, `journal:read`, `journal:write`, `license:write`, `projects:read`, `projects:write`, `shopping:read`, `shopping:write`, `tasks:read`, `tasks:write`. Repeatable. |
| `--expires-in-days` | `1..365` | no | Token lifetime in days (default 90). Cannot be combined with `--never-expires`. |
| `--never-expires` | - | no | Issue a token without an end date; revoke it with revoke-token when done. Cannot be combined with `--expires-in-days`. |

### `sidekick-admin list-tokens`

List a user's personal tokens as JSON (never the token itself).

| Argument | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--user-id` | `USER_ID` | yes | The user to list for. |

### `sidekick-admin revoke-token`

Revoke one personal token.

| Argument | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--token-id` | `TOKEN_ID` | yes | The token to revoke. |

### `sidekick-admin disable-user`

Disable a user so none of their credentials work.

| Argument | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--user-id` | `USER_ID` | yes | The user to disable. |

### `sidekick-admin empty-trash`

Permanently remove everything in the trash (counts only unless --yes is given).

| Argument | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--yes` | - | no | Really delete; without it the command only prints how many records it would delete. |
| `--older-than` | `DAYS` | no | Only records that have been in the trash for at least this many days. |

## `sidekick-backup`

Create, verify, extract, import and prune encrypted local backups.

Run it with:

```
uv run --project backend sidekick-backup <command> [arguments]
```

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`keygen`](#sidekick-backup-keygen) | Generate a Fernet key for a secret store. |
| [`create`](#sidekick-backup-create) | Create an encrypted local owner backup. |
| [`verify`](#sidekick-backup-verify) | Verify and inspect an encrypted backup. |
| [`extract-export`](#sidekick-backup-extract-export) | Write the verified owner export of an encrypted backup to a new JSON file. |
| [`import`](#sidekick-backup-import) | Plan, or with --apply write, the import of one owner into an existing empty owner. |
| [`prune`](#sidekick-backup-prune) | Apply configured backup retention. |

### `sidekick-backup keygen`

Generate a Fernet key for a secret store.

No arguments.

### `sidekick-backup create`

Create an encrypted local owner backup.

| Argument | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--directory` | `DIRECTORY` | no | Override configured backup directory. |

### `sidekick-backup verify`

Verify and inspect an encrypted backup.

| Argument | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | - | yes | The encrypted backup file. |

### `sidekick-backup extract-export`

Write the verified owner export of an encrypted backup to a new JSON file.

| Argument | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | - | yes | The encrypted backup file. |
| `output` | - | yes | The new JSON file to write; never overwritten. |

### `sidekick-backup import`

Plan, or with --apply write, the import of one owner into an existing empty owner.

| Argument | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file` | - | yes | An encrypted backup (.skbackup), a plain owner export .json, or - for stdin. |
| `--target-owner` | `TARGET_OWNER` | yes | The existing empty owner to import into. |
| `--source-owner` | `SOURCE_OWNER` | no | Required if the file holds several owners. |
| `--key-file` | `KEY_FILE` | no | Fernet key file (mode 600); default is SIDEKICK_BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY. |
| `--apply` | - | no | Write the plan given by --plan-checksum. |
| `--plan-checksum` | `PLAN_CHECKSUM` | no | Checksum printed by the plan; required with --apply. |

### `sidekick-backup prune`

Apply configured backup retention.

No arguments.

## `sidekick-owner-export`

Verify an owner export, plan or apply a restore, and write vCard or Markdown files.

Run it with:

```
uv run --project backend sidekick-owner-export <command> [arguments]
```

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`verify`](#sidekick-owner-export-verify) | Verify an owner export manifest. |
| [`plan-restore`](#sidekick-owner-export-plan-restore) | Prepare a write-free restore plan. |
| [`restore`](#sidekick-owner-export-restore) | Apply a previously reviewed restore plan atomically. |
| [`vcard`](#sidekick-owner-export-vcard) | Write the contacts of a verified export as one vCard 4.0 file. |
| [`markdown`](#sidekick-owner-export-markdown) | Write the journal entries of a verified export as Markdown files. |

### `sidekick-owner-export verify`

Verify an owner export manifest.

| Argument | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | - | yes | The owner export JSON file. |

### `sidekick-owner-export plan-restore`

Prepare a write-free restore plan.

| Argument | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | - | yes | The owner export JSON file. |
| `--target-owner-id` | `TARGET_OWNER_ID` | no | Target owner UUID; defaults to the source owner in the export. |

### `sidekick-owner-export restore`

Apply a previously reviewed restore plan atomically.

| Argument | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | - | yes | The owner export JSON file. |
| `--apply` | - | yes | Really write the reviewed plan. |
| `--target-owner-id` | `TARGET_OWNER_ID` | yes | The owner to restore into. |
| `--plan-checksum` | `PLAN_CHECKSUM` | yes | Checksum printed by plan-restore. |

### `sidekick-owner-export vcard`

Write the contacts of a verified export as one vCard 4.0 file.

| Argument | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | - | yes | The owner export JSON file. |
| `output` | - | yes | The vCard file to write. |

### `sidekick-owner-export markdown`

Write the journal entries of a verified export as Markdown files.

| Argument | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | - | yes | The owner export JSON file. |
| `output_dir` | - | yes | The directory the Markdown files go to. |
| `--locale` | `LOCALE` | no | Language of the words the files write themselves (default: SIDEKICK_MCP_APP_LOCALE). One of `sv`, `en`. |

## `sidekick-companion`

Pair, grant, list and revoke companion devices (the Android app).

Run it with:

```
uv run --project backend python -m sidekick.companion.cli <command> [arguments]
```

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`pair`](#sidekick-companion-pair) | Issue a 10-minute, single-use pairing secret. |
| [`grant`](#sidekick-companion-grant) | Add capabilities to a paired device (never removes). |
| [`list`](#sidekick-companion-list) | List the owner's companion devices. |
| [`revoke`](#sidekick-companion-revoke) | Revoke one companion device. |

### `sidekick-companion pair`

Issue a 10-minute, single-use pairing secret.

| Argument | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--label` | `LABEL` | yes | The device's name, e.g. Samsung. |
| `--user-id` | `USER_ID` | no | The owner; default is the only active owner. |
| `--scope` | `SCOPE` | no | Grant this device capability; repeatable, companion scopes only (required unless --preset is given). One of `companion:journal:read`, `companion:journal:write`, `companion:license`, `companion:push`, `companion:shopping:read`, `companion:shopping:write`, `companion:tasks:complete`, `companion:tasks:read`. Repeatable. |
| `--preset` | `PRESET` | no | Named set of capabilities, only when written explicitly: app = tasks, Inköp and Dagbok, notifications, license key (companion:tasks:read + companion:tasks:complete + companion:push + companion:shopping:read/write + companion:journal:read/write + companion:license). One of `app`. Repeatable. |
| `--server-url` | `SERVER_URL` | no | The https address the phone reaches this server on (scheme and host, nothing after); adds a sidekick://pair link that fills in the app's pairing screen. |
| `--device-days` | `DEVICE_DAYS` | no | Device credential lifetime in days, 1 to 90. Default `30`. |

### `sidekick-companion grant`

Add capabilities to a paired device (never removes).

| Argument | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--device-id` | `DEVICE_ID` | yes | The device to add to. |
| `--user-id` | `USER_ID` | no | The owner; default is the only active owner. |
| `--scope` | `SCOPE` | no | Add this device capability; repeatable (required unless --preset is given). One of `companion:journal:read`, `companion:journal:write`, `companion:license`, `companion:push`, `companion:shopping:read`, `companion:shopping:write`, `companion:tasks:complete`, `companion:tasks:read`. Repeatable. |
| `--preset` | `PRESET` | no | Add a named set of capabilities, only when written explicitly (see pair). One of `app`. Repeatable. |

### `sidekick-companion list`

List the owner's companion devices.

| Argument | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--user-id` | `USER_ID` | no | The owner; default is the only active owner. |

### `sidekick-companion revoke`

Revoke one companion device.

| Argument | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--device-id` | `DEVICE_ID` | yes | The device to revoke. |
| `--user-id` | `USER_ID` | no | The owner; default is the only active owner. |

## `sidekick-license`

Store, show and clear the instance's license key.

Run it with:

```
uv run --project backend python -m sidekick.license.cli <command> [arguments]
```

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`set`](#sidekick-license-set) | Store a license key, checked offline. |
| [`show`](#sidekick-license-show) | Print the license state. |
| [`clear`](#sidekick-license-clear) | Remove the stored license key. |
| [`reset-clock`](#sidekick-license-reset-clock) | Set the highest date seen to today (after the clock ran far ahead by mistake). |

### `sidekick-license set`

Store a license key, checked offline.

| Argument | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | - | no | The key; read from stdin when left out. |

### `sidekick-license show`

Print the license state.

No arguments.

### `sidekick-license clear`

Remove the stored license key.

No arguments.

### `sidekick-license reset-clock`

Set the highest date seen to today (after the clock ran far ahead by mistake).

No arguments.

## `sidekick-memory-worker`

Run the derived-memory worker, or rebuild, wipe or forget memory.

Run it with:

```
uv run --project backend sidekick-memory-worker [arguments]
```

| Argument | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--once` | - | no | Run one reconcile pass and exit (with --rebuild-owner: then one pass). |
| `--rebuild-owner` | `OWNER_ID` | no | Mark one owner's rows dirty so the next pass resends them. Cannot be combined with `--wipe`, `--forget-owner`. |
| `--wipe` | - | no | Delete every memory document of every owner and their rows (needs --confirm). Cannot be combined with `--rebuild-owner`, `--forget-owner`. |
| `--forget-owner` | `OWNER_ID` | no | Delete one owner's memory documents and rows (needs --confirm). Cannot be combined with `--rebuild-owner`, `--wipe`. |
| `--and-pause` | - | no | With --wipe: also pause every owner's memory sync before deleting. |
| `--confirm` | - | no | Confirm a destructive --wipe or --forget-owner. |

## `sidekick-worker-health`

Check that a background worker is healthy (used by the container health checks).

Run it with:

```
uv run --project backend sidekick-worker-health [arguments]
```

| Argument | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `worker` | - | yes | The worker to check. One of `automation`, `backup`, `memory`, `push`. |
